description: Answer what to study on one day in a single call: the study sessions your plan gives for that day, with the topic of each session when the exams have topics, plus the spaced repetition reviews that are due that day or are late. Give the same exams and hours you use in build_study_plan, including hours_per_weekday, and the topics you are reviewing with the day you first studied each one. Leave date out and it uses today's date. Dates can be plain text, like Dec 12 or in 3 weeks. Example prompt: "What should I study today? I have a networking exam on 2026-12-12 and I studied routing on 2026-11-27."

date.description: The day to show. Defaults to today. Use 2026-12-12, or plain text like Dec 12, next Friday or in 3 weeks.

exams.description: Exams with name, date and optional hours needed. Leave it out to show reviews only.

date.description: Date of the exam. Use 2026-12-12, or plain text like Dec 12, next Friday or in 3 weeks.

hours_needed.description: Study hours you want to put in. Defaults to 10.

topics.description: Topics of the exam with their own hours, so the plan can say which topic to study on each day.

hours_needed.description: Study hours for this topic. Leave it out to split the exam hours evenly over the topics.

name.description: Name of the topic inside the exam.

hours_per_day.description: Study hours available on a study day.

hours_per_weekday.description: Study hours for each weekday, like [{day: "mon", hours: 2}, {day: "sat", hours: 6}]. Weekdays you leave out use hours_per_day, a weekday with 0 hours is a day off, and days in days_off are always left out.

day.description: Weekday name, like mon, tue, sat or sunday.

hours.description: Study hours on that weekday. Use 0 for a day with no studying.

intervals_days.description: Days after the first study to review.

reviews.description: Topics you are reviewing, with the day you first studied each one.

exam_date.description: Exam date, if any. Reviews on or after it are skipped. Use 2026-12-12, or plain text like Dec 12, next Friday or in 3 weeks.

first_study_date.description: The day you first studied it. Defaults to the day you are asking about. Use 2026-12-12, or plain text like Dec 12, next Friday or in 3 weeks.

start_date.description: First day of the plan. Defaults to the day you are asking about. Use 2026-12-12, or plain text like Dec 12, next Friday or in 3 weeks.

name: what_to_study_today
title: What to study today
